detail_html:
Features:

➧ 4K high-definition video helps you collect clearer videos.

➧ Hot spot WiFi, real-time monitoring. Voice synchronization during video recording.

➧ This wearable camera has video/audio/photo/playback functions.

➧ Equipped with a 1000mAh rechargeable battery, it can provide up to 8 hours of recording time.

➧ Limited to external storage, supports TF cards up to 128GB, and can format the card itself.

➧ Pre - and post recording, never missing any important moments, file protection function keeps you safe.

➧ This police body camera adopts a back clip design, which is practical, lightweight, and easy to place and clip in clothes and pockets.

➧ The multiple advantages and stability of video security cameras make them suitable for a wide range of scenarios, including police, traffic law enforcement, outdoor sports, etc. It has performance and durability that meet a wide range of needs, and can travel with users anytime, anywhere.

Specifications:

*Product Name: Police Camera

*Product model: ZC-M11

*WiFi function: hotspot WiFi (10 meters accessible)

*Screen size: 1.54 inch color screen

*Resolution: 4K/2k/1080P

*Video frame rate: 30fps

*Video format: AVI

*Image ratio: 4:3

*Rotation angle: 180 °

*Motion detection: support

*Night vision function: Supports

*Charging interface: type-c

*Battery capacity: 1000mAh

*Charging voltage: 5V/1A

*Charging time: 2 hours

*Working hours: 8 hours

*Application: Wind Recorder

*Memory card type: Micro SD card

*Memory expansion: up to 128GB Micro SD card (not included)

*Main features: WiFi, video recording, photography, recording, loop recording, motion detection, infrared night vision, file viewing, file deletion, formatting, back clip.

*Language support: Chinese, English, Japanese, French, German, Korean, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Thai, Polish, Czech, Dutch, Turkish.

*Product size: approximately 105 * 40 * 25mm

*Product weight: approximately 70g

*Product color: Black

*Product Material: ABS

The packaging includes:

1 * WiFi camera

1 * User Manual

1 * Type-C cable

detail_html:
🎯 Action Camera Y360 – Your Ultimate Recording Companion
Designed for adventurers, vloggers, and everyday creators who want to capture life in high definition. Whether you’re riding a motorcycle, diving underwater, or filming a travel vlog, this camera is built to keep up with your lifestyle.

💪 Key Features That Make It Stand Out:

  • 4K Ultra HD Lens – Optical glass lens reduces light loss and enhances image clarity

  • Reversible 2-inch Screen – Flip up or down for perfect framing in any situation

  • 140° Wide-Angle View – Capture more of the scene without missing a moment

  • 1/4 Universal Screw Hole – Compatible with most mounts and accessories

  • Waterproof & Shockproof – Built to withstand bumps, vibrations, and wet conditions

  • Long-Lasting 800mAh Battery – Record for up to 6 hours on a single charge

  • Fast Type-C Charging – Get back to filming in just 1 hour

  • Pre-installed 128GB TF Card – Store hours of footage without worry

🔋 Battery & Performance:

  • Battery Life: Approx. 6 hours

  • Charging Time: Approx. 1 hour

  • Charging Port: Type-C

  • Memory: Supports up to 128GB TF card (included)

📋 Specifications:

  • Model: Y360

  • Screen: 2-inch Flip Screen

  • Lens: 4K HD Optical Glass Lens

  • Material: ABS

  • Battery: 800mAh

  • Size: 68 x 58 x 30mm

  • Colors: Black / White / Orange

  • Functions: Photo / Video Recording

⚠️ Important Notes:

  • Do not expose to extreme temperatures

  • Use included mounts for secure attachment

  • Format TF card before first use

  • Compatible with most standard action camera accessories

🎵 Perfect For:

  • Motorcycle & bicycle riders

  • Travel vloggers & content creators

  • Underwater & outdoor enthusiasts

  • Sports & adventure recording

  • Daily life & family moments

  • Size: 68 x 58 x 30mm

  • Colors: Black / White / Orange

  • Functions: Photo / Video Recording

⚠️ Important Notes:

  • Do not expose to extreme temperatures

  • Use included mounts for secure attachment

  • Format TF card before first use

  • Compatible with most standard action camera accessories

🎵 Perfect For:

  • Motorcycle & bicycle riders

  • Underwater & outdoor enthusiasts

product.highlights:
• Capture every amazing moment of your life with this high performance portable ordinary digital camera, built for vloggers travelers and content creators who love crisp vivid footage on the go. This compact handheld digital camera delivers stunning 4K resolution at 4096*2160, that means every frame you shoot is packed with incredible detail, from soft sky gradients to sharp texture of street scenery and natural landscapes, far clearer than standard 1080P output to meet your high demand for professional level recording.
  • ​Equipped with a premium CMOS image sensor, this 4K digital camera offers faster light capture, more accurate color reproduction and better low light performance than ordinary sensors, you can get clear bright images even in dim indoor environments or at sunset, no more grainy blurry shots that ruin your precious memories. It comes with fixed focus that gives you consistent sharpness across most shooting scenarios, you do not need to waste time adjusting focus repeatedly when you want to capture a sudden wonderful moment, fixed focus lets you point and shoot instantly, perfect for quick vlog updates street snap and casual action recording.
  • ​Designed as a portable handheld pocket size digital camera, you can easily slip it into your backpack jacket pocket or crossbody bag without adding extra bulk, it is always ready to go when inspiration strikes whether you are hiking traveling attending a friend's party or just exploring your city. It comes with 3 axis stabilization that keeps your footage smooth and steady even when you are walking running or moving while shooting, no more shaky jumpy footage that makes viewers dizzy, you get cinematic level smooth footage that looks professional right out of camera.
  • ​The 180 degree flip screen gives you full control of your frame when shooting vlogs selfies or low angle high angle content, you can see exactly what you are recording at any angle, the multi angle rotation function lets you adjust the screen to fit your shooting needs easily, whether you are holding the camera up above the crowd or down low to capture a pet's perspective, you always get the perfect framing. This multi functional vlog camcorder is perfect for all kinds of content creation, from daily vlogs travel diaries action sports footage to family event recording, it works great for both beginner creators and experienced hobbyists who want a reliable portable camera that delivers great results.
  • ​The fixed focus design simplifies your shooting process while maintaining reliable image quality, it is especially great for beginners who are still learning how to adjust camera settings, you can focus on telling your story instead of messing with complicated focus settings. The 4K 4096*2160 resolution ensures that your footage looks great on any screen from mobile phones to large 4K TVs, you can crop edit and zoom your footage without losing detail, giving you more flexibility in post production. The high quality CMOS sensor ensures that your photos and videos have natural accurate colors, so your content looks more vivid and engaging to your audience.
  • ​Whether you are an aspiring vlogger who wants to create content on the go, a traveler who needs a compact lightweight camera to document your trips, or someone who just wants a reliable digital camera to capture daily family moments, this 4K portable digital camera checks all the boxes. It combines advanced features like 4K 4096*2160 resolution, high quality CMOS sensor and fixed focus simplicity in a small handheld body, giving you great performance without the high cost of a professional full size camera. Do not miss this chance to get a high performance 4K digital camera that fits in your pocket and helps you capture every amazing moment in stunning detail.

detail_html:
Description

Features:

➧ 4K high-definition video helps you collect clearer videos.

➧ Hot spot WiFi, real-time monitoring. Voice synchronization during video recording.

➧ This wearable camera has video/audio/photo/playback functions.

➧ Equipped with a 1000mAh rechargeable battery, it can provide up to 8 hours of recording time.

➧ Limited to external storage, supports TF cards up to 128GB, and can format the card itself.

➧ Pre - and post recording, never missing any important moments, file protection function keeps you safe.

➧ This police body camera adopts a back clip design, which is practical, lightweight, and easy to place and clip in clothes and pockets.

➧ The multiple advantages and stability of video security cameras make them suitable for a wide range of scenarios, including police, traffic law enforcement, outdoor sports, etc. It has performance and durability that meet a wide range of needs, and can travel with users anytime, anywhere.

Specifications:

*Product Name: Police Camera

*Product model: ZC-8K

*WiFi function: hotspot WiFi (10 meters accessible)

*Screen size: 1.54 inch color screen

*Resolution: 4K/2k/1080P

*Video frame rate: 30fps

*Video format: AVI

*Image ratio: 4:3

*Rotation angle: 180 °

*Motion detection: support

*Night vision function: Supports

*Charging interface: type-c

*Battery capacity: 1000mAh

*Charging voltage: 5V/1A

*Charging time: 2 hours

*Working hours: 8 hours

*Application: Wind Recorder

*Memory card type: Micro SD card

*Memory expansion: up to 128GB Micro SD card (not included)

*Main features: WiFi, video recording, photography, recording, loop recording, motion detection, infrared night vision, file viewing, file deletion, formatting, back clip.

*Language support: Chinese, English, Japanese, French, German, Korean, Italian, Russian, Portuguese, Thai, Polish, Czech, Dutch, Turkish.

*Product size: approximately 105 * 40 * 25mm

*Product weight: approximately 70g

*Product color: Black

*Product Material: ABS

The packaging includes:

1 * Camera

1 * User Manual

1 * Type-C cable

product.desc:
Finger-Mounted Design

Innovative finger-mounted design allows for hands-free recording, ideal for sports and adventurous activities.

Versatile Usage

Suitable for various scenarios, from sports events to everyday life, this camera captures all your moments.

Life Recording Device

A versatile tool for recording daily life moments, making it a must-have for vloggers and content creators.

Portable Design

This compact camera is easy to carry around, making it perfect for on-the-go vlogging and recording.

4K Ultra HD Resolution

Capture every detail with the camera's 4K Ultra HD resolution, ensuring high-quality video recordings.

detail_html:
Features:
➧4K HD video, helping you collect clearer videos.
➧Hotspot WiFi, real-time monitoring. Voice synchronization when recording video.
➧This wearable camera has video/audio/photo/playback functions.
➧Equipped with a 1000mAh rechargeable battery, it can provide up to 8 hours of recording time.
➧External storage only, supports TF cards up to 128G, and can format the card by yourself.
➧Record before and after, never miss any important moments, and the file protection function keeps you safe.
➧This police body camera adopts a back clip design, which is practical and lightweight, easy to place and clip on clothes and pockets.
➧The multiple advantages and stability of the video security camera make it suitable for a wide range of scenarios, including police, traffic enforcement, outdoor sports, etc. It has the performance and durability to meet a wide range of needs and can go with users anytime, anywhere.

Parameter:
*WiFi function: Hotspot WiFi (10 meters barrier-free)
*Screen size: 1.54-inch color screen
*Resolution: 4K/2k/1080P
*Video frame rate: 30fps
*Video format: AVI
*Image ratio: 4:3
*Rotation angle: 180°
*Motion detection: Support
*Night vision function: Support
*Charging interface: Type-c
*Battery capacity: 1000mAh
*Charging voltage: 5V/1A
*Charging time: 2 hours
*Working time: about 8 hours
*Application: Wind Recorder
*Memory card type: Micro SD card
*Memory expansion: up to 128GB Micro SD card
*Main features: WiFi, video recording, photo taking, audio recording, loop recording, motion detection, infrared night vision, file viewing, file deletion, formatting, back clip.
* Language support: Chinese, English, Japanese, French, German, Korean, Russian, Portuguese, Thai, Polish, Czech, Dutch, Turkish.
* Product size: about 105*40*25mm
* Product material: ABS

Package include:
1* WiFi camera
1* User manual
1* Type-c cable

Tips:
1. Please read the manual before using this product!
2. Please charge the camera for 2 hours at the first time!
3. Thank you for your understanding and attention, and wish you a pleasant shopping experience!
